reason: The hypothesis combines the active-learning ML potential methodology from P2 (applied to carbonitrides) and P6/P7 (applied to solid-state MPEA properties) and transfers it to the specific problem of thermodynamic integration for liquid-state free energies in refractory HEAs, a combination not proposed in any single passage.
